description:
Types::arrow_params (types/mod.rs:1400) clones the parameter vector of an interned arrow for every reader: about 4,240 allocations. Chains: contract.rs:265 ContractArrow::matched_params (3,216), identity.rs:129 ActivationKey::inputs (about 930), resolve.rs:200 (96).

Change: arrow_params answers a borrowed slice. matched_params / widened_to_row copy only when a variadic tail widens the row. Readers of ActivationKey::inputs that only read borrow; those that keep the vector copy it themselves, visibly.

Evidence: census of the OptionParser probe at develop 01e69178a (771,812 allocations): /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/464fcf92-8f92-4767-a8fb-4e4eea4b6d45/scratchpad/census/01e69178a_top.txt; call chains: cd /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/464fcf92-8f92-4767-a8fb-4e4eea4b6d45/scratchpad/census && python3 chain.py 01e69178a.pkl <file:line> <depth> "" <n>; line numbers are exact in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/464fcf92-8f92-4767-a8fb-4e4eea4b6d45/scratchpad/census/wt-alloc/src (read only).

Signal: full gate green; no golden or pin moves except a falling pin, which is lowered and listed; program output and canonical backend dump identical on the probe; allocation count before and after in the commit.
title: An arrow's parameters are read where they live
